The post says interoperability of the DNIC and DNRN systems is a prerequisite but states no link between civil register and ID system under way or in service.

facts.fact: INAGE, IP says it leads implementation of the Government Interoperability Platform, and its technical group on 12 June 2025 reviewed data mapping between the Bank of Mozambique and the Tax Authority, test-environment preparation and the Security Servers access points of the systems to interoperate.

MOZ.note: The post mentions data protection only as an aim of standardising identifiers; no law is named.
The post describes a future bank-account example, not a service online.
No enrolment count or share is given.
No number at birth is mentioned.
Nothing on who operates or owns the ID system.
Only a future example of a bank querying the tax number and ID data; no register keyed on the ID number is stated.
Nothing on the national ID system's status, biometrics or certification.
The post describes an exchange platform, not an interoperability framework.
Nothing on civil registration offices entering events digitally.
